description: Figure 2 is a multi-line plot illustrating how performance varies with different chunking sizes, with four sources plotted as separate lines. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 200 to 1000 with tick marks at 200-token intervals (200, 400, 600, 800, 1000). The y-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 10 to 40 with tick marks at 10-unit intervals (10, 20, 30, 40). The blue solid line with circular markers (Tutorials) rises from about 24 at 200 tokens to about 27 at 400, about 29 at 600, peaks around 30 at 800, then declines to about 27 at 1000. The orange solid line with circular markers (Library Documentation) starts near 32 at 200, decreases slightly to about 30 at 400 and about 29 at 600, then drops more sharply to about 18 at 800 and about 12 at 1000. The red solid line with circular markers (StackOverflow posts) increases from about 27 at 200 to about 29 at 400 and about 30 at 600, reaches about 31 at 800, then decreases to about 28 at 1000. The green solid line with circular markers (Github files) increases from about 29 at 200 to about 30 at 400 and about 30 at 600, reaches about 32 at 800, then decreases to about 29 at 1000.
